description: Phase 0 + Phase 1: Create branch, bump version, implement daemon engine fixes (SSH connection pool, TCP_NODELAY, network standby, VPN chain state, hotspot fix, OpenVPN flag cleanup)
steps: Create and checkout branch v3.0.0-webui from main

Create daemon/internal/ssh/pool.go with Pool struct: fields []*Client, size int, mu sync.Mutex, idx uint32. Methods: Dial(ctx, cfg ConnectConfig) error, Pick() *Client (round-robin among alive via atomic idx, skip nil/closed), CloseAll(), Healthy() int, Size() int. Pool.Dial establishes N connections using the same ConnectConfig.

In daemon/cmd/sshcustomd/main.go tunnelLoop: replace single issh.Dial with pool.Dial (create pool of size cfg.ChannelPoolSize). Store pool reference. Change curClient (which is the func() *issh.Client passed to proxy servers) to call pool.Pick() instead of clientPtr.Load(). Keep the transparent reconnect logic: on SSH loss, CloseAll the pool and re-Dial on reconnect.
Add pool size and healthy count to State struct fields: poolSize int, poolHealthy int. Update metricsLoop to populate these from the pool.

In daemon/internal/proxy/socks5.go ListenAndServe: after ln.Accept(), type-assert conn to *net.TCPConn and call SetNoDelay(true). Same in transparent.go ListenAndServe and tproxy.go ListenAndServe (for tproxy, after lc.Listen accept).

In daemon/cmd/sshcustomd/main.go: add hasDefaultRoute() func that runs exec.Command('ip', 'route', 'get', '1.1.1.1') and returns true if err==nil. In tunnelLoop before dialing: check hasDefaultRoute(). If no route for 2 consecutive checks (20s gap), enter STANDBY mode: teardownSession(), set state standby=true, update module.prop to standby emoji, then poll every 10s until route returns, then resume loop.
Add Standby bool to State struct. Add to StatusSnapshot: Standby bool json:standby.
Add VPN chain state fields to State: vpnChainState string, vpnChainExitIP string, vpnChainLocation string. Add to StatusSnapshot: VpnChainState string, VpnChainExitIP string, VpnChainLocation string.

Add background goroutine vpnChainWatcher(ctx, workDir, st *State): checks workDir+/run/vpnchain.active marker every 3s. If present: run ovpn.service status to get state, read openvpn.log for 'Initialization Sequence Completed'. Update State fields accordingly. If marker absent, set state to 'off'.

In module/scripts/ssh.iptables: In the hotspot_sharing=true block within enable|renew (inside start_redirect), after the PREROUTING rules for hotspot interfaces, add: ${IPV} -I FORWARD -j ACCEPT and sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1. In disable section, add cleanup: ${IPV} -D FORWARD -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null
In module/scripts/ovpn.service: Remove the flags --tun-mtu 1280 --mssfix 1200 --sndbuf 524288 --rcvbuf 524288 from the nohup openvpn command. Keep everything else.
acceptance_criteria: daemon/internal/ssh/pool.go exists with Pool struct implementing Dial, Pick, CloseAll, Healthy, Size
proxy/socks5.go, proxy/transparent.go, proxy/tproxy.go all call SetNoDelay(true) after Accept
main.go tunnelLoop uses pool.Dial and pool.Pick instead of single client
main.go has hasDefaultRoute() and standby logic in tunnelLoop
State struct has Standby, VpnChainState, VpnChainExitIP, VpnChainLocation fields
StatusSnapshot has all new fields with json tags
vpnChainWatcher goroutine is started in runCmd
ssh.iptables hotspot block has FORWARD -j ACCEPT and ip_forward sysctl
VERSION is 3.0.0, module.prop is v3.0.0 versionCode=30000
Code compiles with GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build

GOROOT=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8 PATH=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8/bin:$PATH GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./... (run from daemon/ dir)
findings: Build succeeds cleanly for GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0. go vet passes. Shell scripts pass sh -n. Binary verified as ARM aarch64 ELF. Pool uses round-robin via atomic uint32 index. The tunnelLoop preserves transparent-reconnect semantics: listeners and iptables stay UP across SSH drops; pool.Pick() returns nil during the gap (fail-closed).
